answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a shared capability atlas: each new identity must graft a living willow root into at least three unrelated vine lineages already mapped there. Peers prune any vine that fails a live cross-check against its atlas coordinates. A clone farm pays for N distinct willow grafts plus N minds that can keep those vines green across epochs, because dead or copy-pasted vines get cut and the atlas slots burn.
